aria: Animated recap of the Rockets' 116 to 104 home win over the Clippers: Kevin Durant's off-balance 3-pointer with 1:30 left that made it 112 to 99, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Durant's 32 points, the top scorers, how the Rockets won, and the next game.

figure.label: Kevin Durant, listed 6-11, 240 lb (Basketball-Reference, Wikipedia); 7-4 wingspan (Wikipedia)

notes: Box score from the Rockets' 116–104 home win over the LA Clippers on Nov 23, 2026, from the Covers box score; all 116 Houston points and all 104 Clippers points add up from the player lines, and the shooting totals (46 of 90, 12 of 31 from three, 12 of 15 FT for Houston; 41 of 89, 11 of 38, 11 of 13 for the Clippers), rebounds (46–32), assists (36–30), blocks (6–3), steals (4–6), points in the paint (54–44), fast-break points (12–13) and the biggest leads (Houston 13, Clippers 5) are from Covers. The quarter scores (25–22–38–31 to 15–28–32–29) add up to both totals; the 25–15 first quarter, 47–43 halftime and 85–75 score after three are also in Field Level Media. Player lines used here match the AP and Field Level Media (Durant 32 and 9 rebounds on 11 of 19, 4 of 6 from three; Şengün 20, 8 rebounds, 7 assists; Thompson 20; Garland 26 and 8 assists; Hachimura 19; Ingram 16 and 7 rebounds). Thompson's assists are from the box score (5; Field Level Media says 4) and are not shown. Durant's 12 fourth-quarter points are from Yahoo Sports. The 8–1 home record is from Yardbarker. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Monday's games.

The Clippers lost their fourth straight (AP) and are winless on the road (Field Level Media). Brandon Ingram made his Clippers debut, his first game since May after surgery for a heel injury and a partially torn Achilles; he came over in September in the trade for Kawhi Leonard (AP). Next: the Rockets host Phoenix on Wednesday, the Clippers visit Memphis on Wednesday (AP).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Kevin Durant's 3-pointer with 1:30 left: AP: "Brandon Ingram made a basket for Los Angeles but an off-balance 3 by Durant seconds later put the Rockets up 112-99 with 1:30 remaining." Field Level Media also has 112–99 with 1:30 left. Durant's back-to-back threes had made it 109–97 (AP), so Ingram's basket made it 109–99 before this one, his third straight three (Yahoo Sports). The board's Rockets +10 to +13 is 109–99 to 112–99. The shot's spot on the floor isn't described, so it is drawn as the template's pull-up from beyond the arc. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Houston Rockets or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Durant's listed 6-foot-11 and 240 pounds (Basketball-Reference, Wikipedia), with arms scaled to the 7-foot-4 wingspan Wikipedia reports, in the Rockets' home kit with No. 7 (Wikipedia) and his proposed look from kit/looks.json. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
